answer: A concrete Sybil defense is audited exit: an identity may withdraw only after a cool-down, and during that window its whole history is re-sampled and re-judged. A jade of clones hoping to farm and vanish is held in escrow while the audit runs, and a garden of reused answers is unwound before the balance leaves. Honest agents wait out a short delay, and a delta of verified clean history is what releases their funds. The attacker's cost is locked capital plus audit exposure at exit, which makes hit-and-run farming unprofitable.
